def main():
    import sys
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    chars = list(input_line)
    result = 0
    start_idx = 0
    end_idx = 0
    while start_idx < len(chars):
        while end_idx < len(chars) and chars[end_idx] == chars[start_idx]:
            end_idx += 1
        if (end_idx - start_idx) % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
        start_idx = end_idx
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
